articles.summary: LOS ANGELES, Dec. 11, 2024 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- AXIL Brands, Inc. (“AXIL” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: AXIL), an emerging global consumer products company for AXIL ® hearing protection and enhancement products and Reviv3 ® hair and skin care products, announces the extension of its product licensing agreement with NASCAR through 2027.
